text: THE SKY IS TURNING BLACK… AND THE MOUNTAIN IS EXPLODING! WHAT IS HAPPENING?!
sents: THE SKY IS TURNING BLACK… AND THE MOUNTAIN IS EXPLODING!

text: I was walking through Pompeii in the year 79 AD. People were shopping, talking, and enjoying an ordinary day.
sents: I was walking through Pompeii in the year 79 AD.
People were shopping, talking, and enjoying an ordinary day.

text: Then suddenly… Mount Vesuvius erupted! A giant cloud of ash shot into the sky.
sents: A giant cloud of ash shot into the sky.

text: People started running. Ash covered the streets, buildings, and rooftops. Nobody understood how dangerous it was.
sents: Ash covered the streets, buildings, and rooftops.
Nobody understood how dangerous it was.

text: I looked up… and realized the entire city was disappearing beneath volcanic ash!
sents: I looked up… and realized the entire city was disappearing beneath volcanic ash!

text: I tried to escape, but everything around me was turning dark. Pompeii would remain buried for centuries.
sents: I tried to escape, but everything around me was turning dark.
Pompeii would remain buried for centuries.

text: And the craziest part? Almost 2,000 years later, people would discover this lost city! SUBSCRIBE TO HISTORY WORLD!
